guard_patterns.handling: Use only the cited official public source for the stated fact.
Keep publication and update dates attached to evidence.
Keep each statistical or policy reference period unchanged.
Keep provisional, in-development and final statistics distinct.
guard_patterns.risk_prevented: Prevents provisional values being presented as final.

guard_patterns.handling: Keep UK, GB, England, devolved and facility scopes distinct.
Keep inventory, registry, MRV, policy and activity bases distinct.
Do not treat activity, deployment or project status as measured emissions.
Do not treat emission factors as measured site or parcel emissions.
Keep infrastructure stocks, annual flows, allocations and cumulative series distinct.
Keep facility, permit, registry and parcel units distinct.
Keep planning, consent, construction and operation stages explicit.
guard_patterns.risk_prevented: Prevents planned projects being treated as operating.

guard_patterns.handling: Keep scheme uptake and installations distinct from emissions outcomes.
guard_patterns.risk_prevented: Prevents programme activity becoming a GHG claim.

guard_patterns.handling: Keep reported physical, allowance and monetary units unchanged.
Keep totals, percentages and denominators explicit.
Retain methodology, guidance and dataset-edition context.
Retain revisions and supersession status.
Keep policy, consultation and commercial frameworks distinct from observed emissions.
guard_patterns.risk_prevented: Prevents policy text becoming fabricated measurements.

guard_patterns.handling: Do not treat announced future releases as available observations.
Do not derive parcel emissions from national, sector, registry, facility or programme data.
Require source, date, scope, basis and unit checks before PASS.
